scope: Enterprise HR operations taxonomy spanning candidate through alumni, with HR accountable for orchestration and specialist partners accountable for their domain decisions.
countingRules: A sub-intent is one observable outcome with one authoritative completion record.
Aliases never create duplicate canonical sub-intents.
A current reference key appears exactly once, either on an atomic leaf or on a service intent when composite.
Jurisdiction-specific entitlement and legal determinations require overlays and human review.

journeys.name: Recruit and select

journeys.name: Onboard and activate workers

journeys.description: Maintain person, worker, organization, position, and lifecycle records.

journeys.name: Capture time and schedule work
journeys.description: Record work time, schedules, overtime, and attendance outcomes.

journeys.name: Administer absence and leave
journeys.description: Process routine absences and protected or extended leave cases.

journeys.name: Manage performance

journeys.name: Deploy and retain talent
journeys.description: Enable internal mobility, succession, and retention actions.

journeys.description: Listen to employees, plan workforce needs, and support organizational change.

journeys.name: Resolve employee relations
journeys.description: Resolve concerns, investigations, discipline, and ethics matters.
